name: you-should-know-forward
description: Pass each "You should know" note to the session's own agent once, marked as a separate model's claim to verify

wakeIdle.title: Wake an idle session
wakeIdle.description: When a note arrives while the session is idle, start a turn with it (at least 2 minutes apart, at most 1 in a row without a prompt you typed, at most 10 per session per day; side-notes has the same limits; each one is a billed turn). Off: the note waits for your next prompt.

logDir.title: Audit log folder
logDir.description: One JSON line per note event (shown, delivered, verdict, owner chat), one file per session, so missed or doubly delivered notes can be counted. Empty turns it off.
